regime_context: Hong Kong is in a narrow, early rotation: only 4 of 17 themes clear the absolute-trend eligibility gate, led by Banks (score 1.31) with Energy H-shares a clear challenger (0.98). The gate has historically helped control drawdown in this market (gate_helps true), so the eligible set is the valid staying-power lens; everything else is attention noise, not alpha. No theme is scorable here (both ETF proxies map to China Tech, which is ineligible), so all leans below are unscorable-by-proxy and get modest conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) can close the 0.33 score gap on Banks and take over the rank-1 eligible slot: the condition to retire this watch is Energy scoring above 1.31 for two consecutive weekly prints while staying eligible.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the lone durable leader: highest score, eligible under the absolute-trend gate, and best durability bar (0.67) among the eligible four. The gate_helps flag means staying with eligible leadership has historically cut volatility/tail in HK, and this is the only leg with validated value. However the theme is unscorable and hurst_tag is 'mixed', so this is a conditional on trend persistence, not a return call.
theses.dissent: Durability is 'mixed' and breadth is 0.69 — leadership is narrow and could rotate to Energy, which has a higher durability bar (0.76) and cleaner 'trend' tag; HK financials also carry policy/rate sensitivity that the detector cannot see.

falsifier.text: Banks' 10-day return falls behind Energy H-shares' 10-day return before the 30-day horizon passes

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the most robust challenger: eligible, second-highest score, and the only theme with a clean 'trend' hurst tag plus the highest durability bar (0.76) and breadth (0.80) in the eligible set. That combination of persistence and breadth is the strongest staying-power signature among the four eligible names, though it remains unscorable.
theses.dissent: Rotation margin over Banks is only 0.33 and absorption is 0.46 — the dominant theme is not ceding; Energy could stay second-best or get mean-reverted by the same global energy cycle that lifted it.

falsifier.text: Energy's score falls below 0.5 or drops out of the eligible set before the 30-day horizon

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the only scorable theme (ETF proxy 3033.HK) and it is deeply ineligible: rank 13, score -0.79, hurst_tag 'mean-revert'. With the absolute-trend gate validated for drawdown control in HK, being on the wrong side of the gate is the clearest risk-control reason to avoid/underweight. As the only scorable name this is also the one testable lean in the note.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tags cut both ways: deeply out-of-favor tech could snap back on a policy or liquidity catalyst, and the negative momentum is already priced; underweighting a mean-reverting name risks missing exactly the reversal that tag warns is coming.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK gains 5% while the Hang Seng gains less than 1% over the next 20 trading days
